title: Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 2
description: Selling my Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 2 as I've upgraded to a newer laptop. It has mainly been used for schoolwork, programming and browsing. There are a few light scratches on the lid from normal use, but everything works properly. Battery lasts around 6–8 hours depending on usage. Original Lenovo charger is included.

title: Apple MacBook Air M1 2020
description: MacBook Air M1 that I used throughout university for assignments, presentations and general work. Still runs smoothly and is very portable. There are minor signs of use on the exterior, but the screen and keyboard are in good condition. Selling because I recently switched to a Windows laptop.

title: ASUS Vivobook 15
description: Barely used ASUS Vivobook 15 that was purchased for school but ended up being used only occasionally. Great for documents, coding, online classes and everyday browsing. No visible damage and the keyboard is clean. Comes with the original charger and box.

title: Dell Inspiron 14
description: Older Dell Inspiron 14 that is still working well for basic schoolwork, web browsing and watching videos. The laptop has visible scratches on the cover and some wear around the keyboard, which is reflected in the price. Battery life is shorter than when new, so it is best used near a power outlet.

title: LG 24-inch Full HD Monitor
description: Selling my LG 24-inch monitor because I recently upgraded to a larger display. It has been used mainly for studying, coding and watching videos. The display is clear with no dead pixels that I have noticed. Includes the original stand and power cable.

title: Samsung 27-inch QHD Monitor
description: Samsung 27-inch QHD monitor bought for a home study setup but barely used. The larger screen is useful for having notes, browser windows and code open side by side. No scratches or display issues. Original stand and cables included.

title: Dell 27-inch USB-C Monitor
description: Dell 27-inch monitor with USB-C connectivity. I mainly used it with my laptop for assignments and working from home. USB-C makes it convenient to connect a compatible laptop without needing multiple cables. There are a few small marks on the stand but the screen itself is in good condition.

title: Keychron K2 Mechanical Keyboard
description: Keychron K2 mechanical keyboard that I used for coding and assignments. The keyboard is still responsive and all keys are working. Some keycaps show light signs of use. Selling because I switched to a smaller keyboard for my desk setup. Includes the USB-C cable.

title: Logitech MX Keys Mini
description: Compact Logitech MX Keys Mini in excellent condition. Bought for a study desk but I ended up using my laptop keyboard more often. The keys are clean and all functions work normally. Comes with the original charging cable.

title: Razer DeathAdder V2 Mouse
description: Razer DeathAdder V2 wired mouse that has been used for both studying and gaming. All buttons and the scroll wheel work properly. There are some minor scratches underneath from normal use. Selling because I switched to a wireless mouse.

title: Logitech MX Master 3S
description: Logitech MX Master 3S in excellent condition. Very comfortable for long study or coding sessions and supports multiple devices. Selling because I received another mouse as a gift. Comes with the original USB-C charging cable and receiver.

title: iPad 9th Generation 64GB
description: iPad 9th generation that was mainly used for taking lecture notes, reading PDFs and watching videos. The screen is in good condition with only minor signs of use on the back. Battery still holds a good charge. Selling together with a basic protective case.

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S8
description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S8 used mainly for handwritten notes, reading lecture slides and streaming. The S Pen is included and works properly. There are a few small marks on the back from normal use, but the screen is in good condition.

title: Casio FX-991EX Scientific Calculator
description: Casio FX-991EX scientific calculator used throughout my engineering modules. All buttons and functions are working normally. There are some light scratches on the cover from being carried in my bag. Useful for students taking mathematics, engineering or science modules.

title: Casio FX-991CW Scientific Calculator
description: Casio FX-991CW in very good condition. Bought for a university module but only used for a few tests. No scratches on the screen and all buttons work properly. Includes the original protective case.

title: Engineering Mathematics Textbook Bundle
description: Selling a small bundle of engineering mathematics textbooks that I used during my first two years of university. Some pages have highlighting and handwritten notes, but the books are complete and easy to read. Selling the bundle together to clear space.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms Textbook
description: Data Structures and Algorithms textbook used for university programming modules. There are some highlighted sections and a few notes in the margins, but the pages are otherwise clean. Good option if you want a physical reference instead of relying only on lecture slides.

title: Sony WH-1000XM4 Headphones
description: Sony WH-1000XM4 noise-cancelling headphones used mainly for studying and commuting. Noise cancellation and Bluetooth connection work properly. The ear cushions show some normal wear but are still comfortable. Comes with the carrying case and charging cable.

title: Anker Soundcore Q30
description: Soundcore Q30 wireless headphones that I used for online classes and studying. The active noise cancellation is useful in noisy environments and the battery still lasts well. Some minor marks on the headband from regular use. Charging cable included.

title: UGREEN 9-in-1 USB-C Dock
description: UGREEN USB-C dock purchased for a laptop setup but used only a handful of times. Useful if you need to connect an external monitor, USB devices, SD card or wired network to a laptop with limited ports. Fully working and includes the original packaging.

title: Anker USB-C 7-in-1 Hub
description: Compact Anker USB-C hub that I carried around with my laptop during university. It has been useful for connecting USB drives, HDMI displays and SD cards. Works properly with my laptop and has some minor cosmetic wear from being carried in a bag.

title: Logitech C920 HD Pro Webcam
description: Logitech C920 webcam used for online presentations, meetings and classes. Video and microphone are working normally. There are a few scratches on the mounting clip but they do not affect usage. Includes the original USB cable.

title: Razer Kiyo Webcam
description: Razer Kiyo webcam with built-in ring light. I used it mainly for online presentations and occasional video calls. The camera and lighting work properly. Selling because I no longer need a dedicated webcam after switching to a laptop with a better built-in camera.

title: Acer 24-inch Monitor
description: Acer 24-inch Full HD monitor that has been used as a secondary screen for schoolwork. The display is still working properly, although there are some scratches on the stand and a small cosmetic mark near the bottom bezel. A budget-friendly option for a second screen.

title: Microsoft Surface Laptop 4
description: Microsoft Surface Laptop 4 that I used for university assignments, presentations and programming. It is lightweight and easy to carry between classes. There are a few minor marks on the exterior from regular use, but the screen and keyboard are in good condition. Original charger included.

title: iPad Air 4 64GB
description: iPad Air 4 that I used for lecture notes, reading and annotating PDFs. The tablet is still responsive and the screen is in good condition. Selling because I have graduated and no longer use it regularly. Includes a protective case but no Apple Pencil.

title: Logitech K380 Bluetooth Keyboard
description: Small and portable Logitech K380 Bluetooth keyboard. I used it with my tablet and laptop when studying outside. All keys work normally and the keyboard is easy to carry around. There are some light marks on the back from regular use.

title: JBL Tune 760NC
description: JBL Tune 760NC wireless headphones used mainly for commuting and studying. Noise cancellation and Bluetooth connection are working normally. There is some minor wear on the ear cushions from regular use. Comes with the charging cable.

title: HP Pavilion 15
description: HP Pavilion 15 used throughout university for documents, programming assignments and online meetings. It is still in good working condition with some light cosmetic wear around the palm rest. The laptop has been kept in a sleeve when not in use. Includes the original HP charger.

title: Casio FX-9860GIII Graphing Calculator
description: Casio FX-9860GIII graphing calculator used for engineering and mathematics modules. It is fully functional and the screen is clear. There are some scratches on the outer casing from being carried around during school. Includes the USB cable and protective cover.
